title: My experience
content: Hey!! I'm so glad I found this community. I'd love to share my mall dreams!! I always dream of the same mall, it has a very vintage feel to it. It always has warm amber lighting and wooden guard rails. It has 3 main floors, and one secret lower floor. The lower floor is usually kept pristine, a time capsule of the 90's. The stores are closed, but the merchandise remains. It smells like my kindergarten class did.. The food court is sometimes connected to a water park, and I find myself always getting lost on my way to go get boba. Anything else, I have no issue finding. There are no stairs, only tiny, cramped elevators that are guarded by various people. The most notable guard is an older lady who always harasses me when I try to go between floors. There is one shop that I always gravitate towards, a clothing store that also sells pop culture merch. Its huge, but small at the same time?? Sometimes I'd dream about walking through the mall with a friend, but that's not very common. There is an arcade as well, but it's connected to an ice rink. The ice rink gives me the chills (pun not intended). It's small, cramped, and dark. There's no real room on it. The movie theater is gigantic. It has red carpeting, and stairs to go to an upper level, which is usually where I go to watch a movie. I'll try to find some pictures that look similar. I'm so glad I found this community. I have so much to talk about. I also have a whole "mind world" as I like to call it. It's a near 1:1 copy of the real world, but super strange and off-putting. Sometimes I'd drive through a cemetery to get to a town I have no recollection of. Byt that's a story for a different day! ETA: Sometimes I'd dream of an airport. I'm usually late for a flight, but always make it on time. The planes are sometimes REALLY tiny and scary to fly in (Which is weird because I LOVE flying.). There is also a hospital, but the nurses and doctors are awfully rude, and patients would lay in a huge, open room with extremely bright lights...
